title: Your Unfair Advantage, Set Up First
lede: Everything in this course runs through Jarvis. Before you pick a market or write an offer, the thing that does the work needs to exist.
body:
In this module, you’ll set up your own Jarvis, give it your business details and load the skills we use throughout the business.

You’re doing this first so you can give Jarvis a task and have it work from your goals and saved information, instead of explaining everything again each time. You’ll also set up the CRM where your leads, follow-ups and client work will live.

By the end, you’ll have Jarvis set up with your skills and business context, your pipeline ready and a first task tested.
